profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Assurant | Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
At Assurant, our team has consistently delivered cutting-edge software solutions, leveraging my expertise in C#, MVC, Angular, SQL and .NET Framework to drive technological innovation. My role as Lead Software Engineer builds on a solid foundation of over four years at Assurant, where I've honed my skills in developing robust systems that enhance our financial services offerings.

Collaborating with a dynamic team, we've empowered our organization with efficient and scalable software architectures. My professional journey reflects a commitment to engineering excellence and a passion for solving complex problems through high-quality code and system design.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designing and implementing user interface for high performance, highly available and scalable web applications.
Prepare technical designs, perform code reviews, debugging and testing.
Provide inputs in designing, and implementing a Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) for the application development group.
Develops, maintains, and improves critical internal and external production .NET applications, based on business requirements using current development technologies.
Ensures all programming, design, data validation and quality control standards are met.
Integrate OPKO PathApps software solutions with 3rd party interfaces and/or with existing systems.
HTML5, CSS3, Single Page App – (SPA) with KnockoutJS, DurandalJS and BreezeJS
ASP.NET MVC, WebAPI and WCF
positions.insights: Skills: Data Science · Front-End Development · ASP.NET Core · Object Oriented Design · Web Development · Git · Software Testing · .NET Core

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer using ORACLE, Java, C# and PowerBuilder.
Responsibilities: 
- Creation of scripts to migrate data from legacy system into TRAX Software
- Design / Test / Debug PL/SQL scripts and Oracle Packages
- Worked closely with implementation and design team to meet customers exact needs
- Travel to customer location and provide on-site programming assistance
positions.insights: Skills: Data Science · Front-End Development · ASP.NET Core · Object Oriented Design · Web Development · Git · Software Testing · .NET Core

positions.title: Computer Science Student
positions.description:
- Design and development of the website On-Line Games. Developed with JavaScript, PHP and MySQL.
- Analysis, design and development of a website for the Research Group of Databases of the
Mathematics and Computer Science Faculty in University of Havana. Developed in Visual Studio 2008
with ASP.NET, LINQ and SQL Server 2005.
- Zoo Project. Design and implementation of a classification system of animals according to their
characteristics using algorithms for classification, genetic algorithms and neuronal networks.
- Analysis, design and implementation of a virtual perfume shop. Developed with Django and Python.
- Analysis, design and implementation of a compiler for the Tiger language. Developed with C# in Visual
Studio 2008.
- Implementation of the Tree Size Program. Developed in Linux with C and Python.
- Implementation of an Editor and Slides Viewer with animations (similar to Microsoft PowerPoint).
Developed in Visual Studio 2003 with C# and XML.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Object Oriented Design
